The '''''Darkness''''' was a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|battlecruiser]] that served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]]. It saw action in the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]. It would later be replaced by the [[Oppressor (Harrower-class)|''Oppressor'']] as Angral's flagship.
